issue.title: test_visual_idle.py errors under just check full lane without pinned visual renderer stack
issue.description: During commit_obligation_instructions verification on 2026-08-24, `just check` escalated to the full fast suite and reported 16 setup errors from tests/ace/tui/visual/test_visual_idle.py. Direct rerun of that file reproduced all 16 errors immediately. The shared failure is RendererEnvironmentError from tests/ace/tui/visual/conftest.py before test bodies run: the renderer fingerprint expects Python 3.12.11 era packages and resvg-py, but this workspace is Python 3.14.7 with newer markdown-it-py, mdit-py-plugins, pillow, pygments, rich, textual, tree-sitter, and no resvg-py. The current implementation diff only touches finalizer/xprompt/docs/memory instruction text and does not affect ACE visual renderer setup. Scope: keep visual-idle tests out of the ordinary non-visual just check lane or make the lane install/skip/report the pinned renderer stack coherently.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic setup failure, not intermittent: `.venv/bin/pytest tests/ace/tui/visual/test_visual_idle.py -q` reproduced 16/16 setup errors on the same tree with the same RendererEnvironmentError before any test body ran. This is an environment/selection contract failure, not a pass-on-rerun flake.

payload.description: adjacent visual-lane report surfaced while triaging the 360-golden mismatch; not the same defect

payload.entry: Stale-bead sweep 2026-08-27 (project owner asked for a review of every open task bead in sase and bob-cli). Verified at master eaf4ea891 in workspace sase_15 after just install. Commit 9cf604978 (2026-08-25, one day after this bead was filed) added 'pytestmark = pytest.mark.visual' at tests/ace/tui/visual/test_visual_idle.py:24. tools/run_pytest:97 sets FAST_MARKER_EXPRESSION = "not slow and not visual", applied at lines 358/363/382, so the file is deselected from the ordinary just check / just test lanes. That is exactly the first remediation this bead's scope named ('keep visual-idle tests out of the ordinary non-visual just check lane'). Renderer-stack coherence for the dedicated just test-visual lane remains covered by sase-up and sase-u4.

payload.close_reason: Obsolete: test_visual_idle.py now carries pytestmark = pytest.mark.visual, and tools/run_pytest excludes 'visual' from the default lane, so it can no longer error inside just check.
